title: Karnataka CM to lead delegation to Japan to explore investments
summary: Karnataka Chief Minister D K Shivakumar will lead a high-level state government delegation to Japan from November 23 to 25.
llm_summary: Karnataka’s chief minister, D K Shivakumar, will head a high‑level state delegation to Japan from Nov 23‑25. The mission aims to pitch Karnataka’s tech ecosystem—its startups, IT parks and clean‑energy projects—to Japanese investors and firms, seeking partnerships and funding
